articles.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow

events.summary: Twelve maritime vessels were struck in a single week near the Strait of Hormuz according to UK maritime data analyzed by BBC Verify. The surge in attacks has reached a record high as oil exports slow down.
events.why: Threats to this critical maritime chokepoint can severely disrupt global energy flows and spike worldwide economic volatility.

articles.title: Yemen: WFP warns of potential ‘humanitarian catastrophe’ as fighting blocks aid delivery

events.summary: Intensifying fighting, blocked roads, and shifting frontlines in Yemen have cut off life-saving food assistance to 800,000 people, the UN World Food Programme reported.
events.why: Severing aid access directly threatens hundreds of thousands of people with acute starvation in an already catastrophic humanitarian crisis.

articles.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian refineries as Zelenskyy says 'we're done'
Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce

events.summary: Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries after President Zelensky announced the end of a pause following fresh Russian attacks. Russia subsequently accused Ukraine of attacking refinery infrastructure.
events.why: The resumption of refinery strikes marks an escalation targeting strategic energy infrastructure, directly impacting fuel supplies and wartime economies.

articles.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
At the scene of a school roof collapse in Pakistan
School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
Pakistan school roof collapse kills at least 34 children and teacher

events.summary: At least 33 pupils and a teacher were killed when a school roof collapsed through three classrooms in Pakistan. Police reported that multiple children were buried under the debris.
events.why: The mass casualty incident highlights critical failures in local school structural safety, causing severe loss of young lives.

articles.title: M 6.6 - 12 km W of Río Grande, Panama
M 7.7 - 12 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba, Panama

events.summary: A major earthquake of up to magnitude 7.7 struck near Pitaloza Arriba and Río Grande in Panama at a shallow depth of approximately 24 km. The event produced a yellow PAGER alert with strong ground shaking reported.
events.why: High-magnitude shallow shaking poses direct threats of structural damage, injuries, and local infrastructure disruptions.

articles.title: Letters with 'suspicious substances' sent to US senators and election offices

events.summary: Letters containing suspicious substances were delivered to US senators and election offices across multiple states, including Oklahoma, Ohio, and Louisiana.
events.why: Coordinated targeting of election infrastructure and federal officials represents a serious threat to democratic operational security.

articles.title: Health workers tackle taboos over drinking with new AI tool

events.summary: The World Health Organization has launched a new AI-powered hub designed for health professionals to identify alcohol-related risks and discuss issues like alcohol-induced cancer with patients.
events.why: It equips global healthcare workers with standardized AI tools to address public health taboos and chronic disease risks linked to alcohol.

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Libya in the spotlight amid ‘encouraging progress’

events.summary: The UN envoy warned the Security Council that institutional divisions, economic deterioration, and security fragility continue to threaten stability in Libya despite political progress.
events.why: Continued instability in Libya risks renewed civil conflict and regional geopolitical destabilization in North Africa.

articles.title: WHO calls for urgent health action across the Eastern Mediterranean

events.summary: The head of the World Health Organization called for urgent action to promote and protect health across the Eastern Mediterranean region. The region encompasses major humanitarian crises including Sudan, Yemen, and the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
events.why: It highlights systemic collapses of healthcare infrastructure affecting multiple active conflict zones concurrently.

articles.title: School headscarf ban sparks rare protests in Azerbaijan and row with Turkey

events.summary: A ban on school headscarves in Azerbaijan has led to pupils wearing hijabs being turned away, sparking rare domestic protests. The policy has also triggered a diplomatic dispute between Azerbaijan and Turkey.
events.why: The dispute impacts civil liberties and religious rights while straining key bilateral diplomatic relations between Turkey and Azerbaijan.

articles.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania

events.summary: Thousands of student demonstrators set government buildings on fire in Albania during their second day of protests. The students are demanding improved university conditions and better job prospects.
events.why: Escalating civil unrest and attacks on state buildings indicate acute socio-economic instability and youth disenfranchisement in Albania.
